title: Transparent Status Effects
description: This resourcepack makes the backgrounds of the status effects in the HUD and inventory transparent
body:
This resourcepack removes the background from the status effect displays in the HUD and inventory.

![Comparison with Resoucepack Off and On](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91b3665ef930e7661bf63332f750b25543bcebeb.png)

This is pack is based on the resource pack [Transparent GUI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ziy-transparent-gui) by 紫芸SaMa / [ZiYun](https://modrinth.com/user/ZiYun). It already removed the background inside the inventory and I reused the transparent sprite from that to also remove the HUD icon backgrounds.
